title: Petition of the Town of Concord Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in the rate of depreciation from three percent to five percent for the year 1990.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Tierney, Alexander (90-11-G).
Petition of the Concord Municipal Light Plant for authorization and approval of an increase in depreciation rate, on the cost of plant from 3% to 5% for the year of 1990.
